x: Dave Ansell, still not completely free from injury, finished third in the long jump with a plus 21 feet leap. Alan Black and Clive Shippen ran in the 3,000 metres steeplechase, but with 3 laps to go Alan dropped out when in 2nd place, leaving Clive to finish third in 9-57.0.

His victory in the long jump was no surprise, for with the absence of his "twin", Dave Ansell, Jim's only serious rival was Norman Caves; although young Derek Wade gave them both a scare by recording six valid jumps between 18'3½" and 18'10".
Coach Dave Ansell achieved a lifetime best in the shot and with his generous handicap mark of 15'3" took 1st prize from Tony Brooks and John Kelly.

A poor entry of only eight competitors for the Shot Putt handicap but nevertheless an enjoyable competition won by Lyle Moar with a personal best and Dave Ansell 2nd with a special handicap for taking part in his best suit.

The 'Southern' Long Jump was one of the closest events at this meeting and was a triumph for Dave Ansell.
